style: Stylized cute chibi 3D game character asset (big head, small body, soft rounded forms), polished hand-painted PBR-like texture with fine detail, soft even studio lighting, orthographic {view} view, centered on a pure white background, no ground shadow, no text, no watermark. Keep EXACTLY the same silhouette, proportions, pose and framing as the source image (it is the size/shape guide); only add shape detail, surface detail and color. Show nothing else.
fabric: Fabric in neutral off-white / very light grey so it can be color-tinted later; small fixed parts (buttons, zipper, laces, soles, stripes, patches) keep their own colors.
hair: Hair color neutral light grey with soft strand shading (it is tinted later). Chunky stylized hair locks with clear strand grooves. Only the hair piece itself: no head, no face, no skin.
